en.text:
Weapon Kills grant a Stack of Heating Up for #e${5.5+#d} seconds. Maximum of 2 Stacks.

Benefits at 1|2 Stacks of Heating Up:
• 15|30 Stability
• 20|40 Recoil Direction
• 15%|25% decreased Accuracy Cone Size
• 15%|25% decreased <title Accuracy Cone Growth [G_conegrowth] />

Buff remains active while stowed.

#e Buff Duration is increased by 1 second.
